claim: Four of the five describe Studio in the same terms, APIs and events plus the Data Cloud
earlier_receipt: Woodhead (Simplecast transcript): "Aladdin Studio is essentially the user experience ... as a set of APIs events. The Aladdin Data Cloud built on top of Snowflake". Goel (my transcription of the public MP4): "make every single event that happens in Aladdin available to you ... via an event, via an API"; "a near real time data store in the form of ADC". Corpus ts.txt has 0 matches for 'studio'. Newman (blackrock.com page): "Aladdin data cloud specifically comes in, which is part of Studio"; "those analytic APIs". No 'event' appears in the transcript. Khara (my transcription of the public MP4): "what we call the Aladdin studio [e]state ... interact with our data, with their data, with reporting with dashboards on a programmatic basis at machine scale". He uses no API, event or Data Cloud wording. Miller corpus 17_...md has 0 matches for studio, API, event or developer.
earlier_finding: Overstated. Only Woodhead names APIs, events and the Data Cloud while calling it Studio. Goel names all three but never says "Studio"; his frame is "opening up Aladdin". Newman names APIs and the Data Cloud but not events. Khara describes only programmatic access to data, reporting and dashboards. Suggested wording: "Four of the five describe overlapping parts of Studio: programmatic access through APIs (Woodhead, Goel, Newman; Khara in general terms), events (Woodhead, Goel) and the Data Cloud (Woodhead, Goel, Newman)." Exhibit 7's title and its Yes marks for Khara and Newman have the same problem (outside this batch).
